notes.title: v0.903 Chinese and French translations, and more.
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Chinese translation added to the game.
- French translation added to the game.
- When map is opened, hitting map key will now close the map.
- Default map key changed to Q.
- Map no longer can be opened using next/previous weapon keys.
- Added gamepad vibration to some events in a game.
- Controls shortcut added to pause menu.
- Added ability to set mouse/gamepad sensitivity in pause menu.
- Player can now switch weapons in air and when he is sprinting.
- Level design changes.
- Fixed bug where music volume slider didn't affected music volume on some levels.
- Fixed bug when music sometimes didn't stop playing when it should have.
- God Rays effect disabled for fastest graphics quality setting to improve performance.
- Pills no longer getting used if player health is full.
- Fixed lack of auto save when player exits out of first cave.
- Lots of small fixes and improvements.

If you think that some other events should also trigger gamepad vibration, leave your suggestion in comments or steam forum.

I know that not everything in input menu is translated. I will look into adding more translation to that menu later.

notes.title: v0.902 Support for more than 50 gamepads.
notes.content:
I've imported new input system into Shadows Peak. This system brought a lot of improvements to the game. Shadows Peak now supports more than 50 gamepads. Full list of all supported gamepads can be found [url=http://guavaman.com/projects/rewired/docs/SupportedControllers.html]here[/url]. There is also new, much more advanced menu for input configuration and improved controls hints.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9098556/833ab8dfccab0eb7b12aa908fc4b263a8d9d1b22.jpg[/img]


[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Player no longer gets easily stuck on corners and trees.
- Game now supports more than 50 gamepads.
- Resolution dialog window at the start of the game removed.
- New in-game key binding menu.
- Controls hints are no longer static, they change depending on buttons that had been bind by player and depending on input device that is currently used.
- Level design changes on seashore level.
- Added ability to change resolution in game options.
- Added ability to set windowed mode in game options.
- Fixed visual artefact caused by bad flashlight cookie.
- Player can now interact with objects when he is sprinting.
- Improved system that switches input between mouse and gamepad in game menus.
- Fixed bug that allowed to get unlimited number of [spoiler]souls from guy in cabin[/spoiler].
- Fixed bug that caused final chapter healing stone to be unusable.
- Small changes and improvements.

I know there's still room for improvements in terms of controls. I will looks into those things in the future.
- Integration of gamepad vibration support.
- Ability to change controls from pause menu.

notes.title: v0.510 Final Chapter added to the game!
notes.content:
Final chapter has been added to the game. If you finished chapter 1, just click on the "Continue" button in the main menu, watch the final cut-scene for chapter 1 and continue playing the new content. If for some reason something happened to your save file, there is a cheat code to launch the final chapter. Unfortunately, this approach will skip the playable prologue for the final chapter. Here's how to use that cheat code: https://youtu.be/N_9Gui2HiSk

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Final chapter has been added to the game.
- Playable prologue for the final chapter has been added to the game.
- Twisted ankle mechanic added to the game.
- Graphics options significantly improved and streamlined. 
- Level design improvements.
- New music for [spoiler]chapter 1 cave level[/spoiler].
- Added visual feedback, to indicate to the player when he can't run.
- A hint about [spoiler]the Killer’s[/spoiler] location has been added to the [spoiler]church[/spoiler] .
- Credits section has been redesigned.
- FOV difference for running state reduced, because it was causing discomfort for some players.
- Final cutscene for chapter 1 is now skippable. Use Esc to skip it.
- Improved roots climbing in [spoiler]cave level[/spoiler].
- Improved quality of important textures for low graphics quality settings.
- Fastest graphics quality setting has been made more performant.
- Fixed bug where getting underwater would change level fog.
- Fixed bug where the game would load textures with wrong language.
- Fixed bug where music could stop playing after [spoiler]four kills[/spoiler].
- Fixed bug where [spoiler]boss fight with Teddy bear[/spoiler] didn't work properly if you load the game after [spoiler]the boss fight[/spoiler] ended.
- Lots of small changes and improvements.

notes.title: Final Chapter status update
notes.content:
I know that a lot of you want to know about the progress on the final chapter and some of you even think that I've abandoned Shadows Peak. Well, that is not the case. I'm actively working on the final chapter almost every day and this is my full time job. 

In fact, final chapter has been playable from start to finish for some time. It isn't released to the public, because right now it's in the middle of playtesting stage, where playtesters play and I improve the game based on their feedback. Follow the link for more details on my playtesting process if you're interested. http://vintsevych.com/?p=1034 

I also plan to add a short playable section between the two chapters, currently codenamed prologue, to make the story of the final chapter more clear. 

I don't provide specific dates because it's just too damn hard to predict those and I don't want to set false expectations or sacrifice quality to hit a specific date. Here are some screenshots from the final chapter.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8770435/5ddf9eeed9216d8604de56d38331d909b071eb7a.jpg[/img]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8770435/191e3195b000f26fe1df3881917a749e5a63fbd1.jpg[/img]

Happy Holidays and Happy New Year!

notes.title: Final Chapter status update
notes.content:
I know that a lot of you want to know about the progress on the final chapter and some of you even think that I've abandoned Shadows Peak. Well, that is not the case. I'm actively working on the final chapter almost every day and this is my full time job. 

In fact, final chapter has been playable from start to finish for some time. It isn't released to the public, because right now it's in the middle of playtesting stage, where playtesters play and I improve the game based on their feedback. Follow the link for more details on my playtesting process if you're interested. http://vintsevych.com/?p=1034 

I also plan to add a short playable section between the two chapters, currently codenamed prologue, to make the story of the final chapter more clear. 

I don't provide specific dates because it's just too damn hard to predict those and I don't want to set false expectations or sacrifice quality to hit a specific date. Here are some screenshots from the final chapter.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8770435/5ddf9eeed9216d8604de56d38331d909b071eb7a.jpg[/img]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8770435/191e3195b000f26fe1df3881917a749e5a63fbd1.jpg[/img]

Happy Holidays and Happy New Year!

notes.title: Version 0.387 is now live!
notes.content:
Work on chapter two continues, but there were enough improvements in chapter one to warrant a new patch.
 
- Decor improvements.
- Reduced amount of memory used by the game. 
- Changed amount of health points received from medkits and [spoiler]white shadows[/spoiler]. 
- Fixed main menu bug reported by Biblicalreaper. 
- Fixed an issue where the game sometimes asked the player to get a flashlight while the player already has one. 
- Fixed rare crash when player is leaving the cave.
- Small changes and improvements.

p.s. Because of chapter two development, there was a lot of new bugs that needed to be squashed to make 0.387 happen. I want to thank EeuorT and Daniel Maloney for taking the time to find all those bugs.

notes.title: Version 0.381 is now live!
notes.content:
Work on chapter two continues, but there was enough improvements in chapter one to warrant new patch.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Added low quality trees option for low-end computers. This will make trees look ugly, so you should use it only if changing other settings don't bring desired fps.
- Physics configured to behave more realistic and less floaty.
- Combination of low quality settings and high field of view, caused some objects to disappear at a short distance. This is now fixed. 
- Optimization of main level.
- Fixed some bugs in save & load system, that could cause problems for people who want to replay the game.
- [spoiler]Guy in a cabin, can now only be killed with knife.[/spoiler]
- [spoiler]Moved bag with a lighter to a more visible place.[/spoiler]
- Other small gameplay improvements.

notes.title: Version 0.377 is now live!
notes.content:
This is the biggest update yet. Potential spoilers are hidden behind black lines.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- [spoiler]Mini boss[/spoiler] added to the game.
- Gamma adjustment screen added to the game.

- Now you can find explanation for [spoiler]teddy bear[/spoiler] origin.

- New sounds and music added to the game. RIP quake-style jump sound.
- Improved some scares.
- Option menu is now better organized.
- Fixed a bug where music/silence might not trigger when player loads a savegame.
- Fixed a bug where player was looking in wrong direction after level load.
- Fixed a bug where player could receive “batteries died” message when new batteries were already found.
- Lots of other small improvements and fixes.

[h1]Known issues:[/h1]
- Bright water behind roots in  [spoiler]cave level[/spoiler]. This will be addressed in next update.
